versions.subject: rules: suspicious linux patterns
versions.detection:
selection:
   CommandLine|startswith:
      - 'sh -c '
      - 'bash -c '
   CommandLine|endswith:
      - '| bash'
      - '|bash'
      - '| sh'
      - '|sh'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("sh -c *", "bash -c *") CommandLine IN ("*| bash", "*|bash", "*| sh", "*|sh")

versions.subject: new rules: lnx susp shell exec
versions.detection:
selection:
   CommandLine|startswith:
      - 'sh -c '
      - 'bash -c '
selection_exec:
   - CommandLine|contains:
         - '| bash '
         - '| sh '
         - '|bash '
         - '|sh '
   - CommandLine|endswith:
         - '| bash'
         - '| sh'
         - '|bash'
         - ' |sh'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("sh -c *", "bash -c *") CommandLine IN ("*| bash *", "*| sh *", "*|bash *", "*|sh *") OR CommandLine IN ("*| bash", "*| sh", "*|bash", "* |sh")
